feat\(wpt\): implement HTTP-based navigation for WPT tests

This commit implements real browser-like HTTP navigation for WPT tests:

- Browser.zig: Add NavigateOptions with skip_load flag and navigateWithOptions\(\)
- Context.zig: Add LoadPageOptions, loadPageWithOptions\(\) that fetches via HTTP,
  and fix self/window/frames globals as data properties
- browser_adapter.zig: Update runHTMLTest to build HTTP URL from test path,
  remove content-based loading in favor of URL-based loading
- wpt_browser.zig: Update runHTMLTest to navigate to URL, scriptLoaderCallback
  now fetches scripts via HTTP instead of reading from disk
- build.zig: Add port clearing step before WPT server starts
- ReadableStream.zig: Implement ReadableStream.from\(\) spec algorithm

WPT tests now use actual HTTP requests for all content:
- Test HTML is fetched via HTTP from WPT server
- External scripts are fetched via HTTP
- This matches real browser behavior
EOF
\)")
